obligations: Represent the actual randomized action/observation experiment by literal joint-law factorization through the history-measurable policy and observation kernels.
Derive actual conditional expectation of the importance-weighted random observation equals the target action-conditioned kernel mean. Never assume this CE identity as a certificate field.
Prove the actual evidence lies in [0,1/pi_min] from bounded predictable test and positive recorded target propensity.
Connect the derived mean identity and adaptedness to full strengthened P66 countable-rule interval-width anytime theorem.
Keep arbitrary measurable sample/history/observation spaces; only the action set is explicitly finite. No StandardBorel assumption is introduced.
Actual zero-coverage experiment must witness nonidentifiability, and positive half coverage must refute omitting range inflation.
scope_limits: The target is the action-conditioned mean along actual encountered contexts. No reset-population identification or alternate long-run occupancy claim.
The conditional experiment factorization is an explicit scientific randomization/observation assumption, not derived from passive observational association.
Pointwise test bounds, known recorded policy probabilities and exact experiment law are inputs.
record_provenance: Recorded during development after the one-step identity and sequential AE bridge had compiled, before the anytime capstone or final audit; not a retrospective predevelopment record.
